reviews.title: Inline-image extent from ASCII85 end marker
reviews.decision_slice_reviewed: The §8.9.7 inline-image extent route uses the ASCII85 marker so it does not search into encoded bytes for an `EI` token. The draft only touches buffered and pumped decode EOF policy, not this extent algorithm.
reviews.assessment: The cited normal and truncated-window assertions are directionally aligned with the route's purpose. This audit does not revalidate the specific image sample arithmetic or certify ADR 0464.

reviews.title: Windowed filter chains and route-specific damaged prefixes
reviews.decision_slice_reviewed: A damaged prefix policy differs by consumer: buffered structural streams refuse corrupt ASCII85, while the windowed content route returns the already-decoded prefix with Damage::Corrupt. The same rationale cautions against demanding identical error types or prefix retention across routes.
evidence: doc/adr/0587-the-chain-a-window-learned.md, section 'The prefix that belongs to one route only'
reviews.assessment: The rationale is coherent for corrupt alphabet/groups and separately avoids unbounded whole-buffer decode for chains. It does not explicitly settle an incomplete final `~` across both routes; I label that as reporting-policy ambiguity, not as an ISO reader conformance defect.

reviews.title: Do not infer an unstated filter
reviews.decision_slice_reviewed: A stream without /Filter is raw data; no sniffer tries Flate or another decoder based on bytes.
reviews.assessment: Matches Table 5 and §7.4.1. This audit did not find a reason to reopen or an assertion that would justify trying an unstated filter.

reviews.decision_slice_reviewed: The host owns supplied stream bytes; this public PDF syntax/model route refuses external stream data instead of opening a path itself.
reviews.assessment: The producer-side semantics that embedded bytes are ignored are exercised and the API boundary is explicit. No external I/O or promise of external-file retrieval was found. This is a scoped review, not whole-ADR certification.

open_decision.recommendation: Keep ambiguous unless the public decode-report contract intends uniform whole-buffer and pump diagnostics. If the parent wants uniformity, use the included candidate as an API/reporting-policy regression and retain the distinction that malformed producer data does not create a mandatory ISO refusal policy.
open_decision.not_a_claim: This is not a finding that ISO mandates rejection of a length-delimited truncated ASCII85 filter stream.
